items.note: S1.3 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the three-stage map (X,Y)->(-Y,X) and restoration of arbitrary scratch values, quoting the forward-invocation clause of Lemma lem:scalar-motifs. No account of the eight-row schedule, the cancellation (JV+RG)x=x, the triple indexing or h=100.

S1.4 gives the frames D_v, the invariant that stored arrays are D_v applied to logical arrays, commutation with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the edge changes D_vD_u^{-1}, matching lines 804-817. It is an infer step, so it is not a derivation.

The structural half is there: nested nondegenerate labels, with the central-wire returns as the only losses (the quote adds loss h, time 3 to 4). Missing are the ambient space F^{tensor 3}, L=Ich, the budget sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L and L/N=100/539 or 101/539. The step concludes s<Wm directly from nesting.

S1.6 correctly states the endpoint identity on every input role, the shear H<-H+D and s_b<W_b m. It omits the projection matrices P_U, the negative source projection -P_{U_a} and the rank-sum formula s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.

B1 states the binary labels, the Hadamard-conjugated phase frames, the edges as products of translation kernels aI+bX_v and C^{tensor e} on every role. It does not say there is one kernel per orthonormal residual vector, gives no formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and leaves out the diagonal corrections. B3 supplies only s_c<W_c m.

The plan repeatedly states s<Wm and s/W<m^tau with tau<1. It never gives the reason L<N/2, the deficits eta_b and eta_c, or the explicit exponent tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} with its derivation from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20.

Both lemmas are stated in substance. S1.2 drops the condition that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time and the restrictions on the prime and the units, and S1.1 does not mention the cyclic row split into W streams.

S1.7 states A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones, and S1.8 states exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), both correct. The method is only named (triangular factors, controlled shifts): the three-update trick that turns each one of Pi into a single interchange (lines 1436-1440) is absent.

S1.9 correctly states s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), F_k=O(e^tau) and the depth-first schedule, and the siblings supply the frames, the shear and the per-edge cost. Two steps of the paper's proof are missing: the conversion of the shear into an interchange by D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D (lines 1535-1541), and the explicit cyclic row split into W role streams.

S1 states O(Vu^tau) correctly, and S1.10 names the reduction to power widths using high digits as rows. It leaves out the padding of rows to a multiple of W^k, the base-m decomposition of the remaining width and the padding of binary ranges to [q^e].

Present: s_c calls on slots of e/m axes (B3), binary basis changes by row additions (B2) and the one-dimensional H_0=bSCS (B1). Missing: conjugation by P_M that moves kernels to coordinate slots, the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, and the full layer identity H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D.

B2 gives the mechanism correctly: a constant number of whole-chunk cyclic shifts, then repair of a bounded exceptional set, with a third chunk used as scratch only via the quote. It has neither the bad-set fraction delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} nor the cost bound O(V(L^tau+1)).

B3 correctly gives s_c children of e/m axes, each with 1/W_c of the volume, and the result O(d^{lambda'}). It omits the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), the leaves at e<d^beta, the rows taken from the first q_0 chunks and the base-m summation.

B states the layer, the single truncation, O(Vd^{lambda'}) and error below sqrt2 2^{-p}. B1-B5 follow the proof: phase frames, packed basis changes, the recursion with 1/W_c volume, exact dyadic evaluation with guard width O(d^20)=o(p), and absolute row sum one giving the disk and truncation bound.

Present and correct: the ring, character cancellation with F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed stored order, and the layout L with its error and cost. The construction of L (prefix-slot moves costing dK, at most Dq-1 width-K chunk exchanges costing pK^{tau-1}) and the per-round contraction-plus-truncation error argument are only asserted.
D1 states evaluation at 2^{4p}, the four integer products by the established multiplier, centered read-back and the O(rp log(rp)) cost, in agreement with the lemma.

D's statement of (f*g)/T, the error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} and the cost is correct, and D2 follows the proof: retained LB order, pointwise product, opposite transform, exact scaling by M. The normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M F^-f F^-g and the error accounting are not given.

M1 and M2 state P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions and the tensor form with line cost O(dTp^{3/2+delta}alpha). The hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4 are omitted, as are the definitions of P_s and P_t; N-I is mentioned without definition.

Both identities are stated exactly: QF_t u = abar.(a*(abar.u))/T, and R cancels to (u*v)/S^2. The chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is never defined, and the conjugation route to RF^+ is missing.

M5 gives b, p=6b, d, K, T, t_i in {r/2,r}, primes just below t_i with T/2<S<T, Tp=Theta(n) and the growth of r. The fixed rational values (tau, lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, delta), alpha and the window (1-2eta)t_i<s_i<=(1-eta)t_i are missing; kappa appears only in S0.
M7 correctly states Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i}, the isomorphism and the triangular controlled shifts. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the triangular digit formula are not given.
M8 states the coefficient twist by zeta^k, zeta=e^{pi i/r}, as an isomorphism C[x]/(x^r-1) -> C[y]/(y^r+1) under which the cyclic wrap is recovered, as in the paper.

The M subtree follows the paper's pipeline: Phi, two source transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, rescale, round, carries. Missing: the composition of the source transform (A, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma), the conjugation definition of F^+ and the input scaling 2^{-b-2}. M9 and M10 misstate the second rescaling as 2^{2b+4} instead of 2^{2b+4}S.

M10 states final error below 1/2, then rounding to exact coefficients and carries. The error chain (E_s, E_w, the bound 448b2^{-b+gamma}, gamma<=b/4) is missing, and the scales are misstated as S and 2^{2b+4}.

S3 correctly gives the normalization by Tp, margins below one, min margin 2^{-181}=2kappa and absorption of polylog factors. It does not list the cost terms or identify the minimal margin g_2=epsilon c(1-tau).
S0 relies on the n log n conjecture and its motivation cites Theta(n log n), but no step states the liminf negation of the eventual lower bound.

errors.says: Two exact rescalings by S and 2^{2b+4} follow the opposite transform.
errors.paper: Step 4 multiplies by S; step 5 multiplies by 2^{2b+4}S. The total factor 2^{2b+4}S^2 undoes the 1/S^2 of the permutation-cancellation identity and the 2^{-b-2} input scaling of each operand.

errors.says: Undoing the known scales S and 2^{2b+4} leaves coefficient error below 1/2.
errors.paper: The scales are S and then 2^{2b+4}S; the error bound (eq:final-error) is computed with the factor 2^{2b+4}S applied to E_w, which already contains one factor S.

errors.says: Nested labels whose only losses are the central-wire returns imply that the total rank of the edge changes satisfies s<Wm.
errors.paper: Nesting gives the budget Wm-2N+2L. The rational interface adds N source ranks, so s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and the strict saving needs L<N/2, i.e. L/N=100/539.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. S1 gives the fast interchange through the network recursion, and B, C, D and M give the simultaneous layer, synthetic transform, ring convolution and multiplication pipeline, which S3 sums with margin 2^{-181}. It is thinnest at the source of the saving, where labels jump to s<Wm without the budget Wm-2N+2L, the projection ranks or L/N<1/2, and the explicit tau=1-2^{-50} is never derived. The cost terms behind the 2^{-181} margin are asserted, not assembled, and the final rescaling is misstated in M9 and M10.

steps.note: S1.3 has the gate types, the map (X,Y)->(-Y,X) and restoration of scratch wires. It lacks h=100, the indexing by triples and N, m=h^3, so the defining quantities are absent.
Frames D_v, commutation with pointwise gates, D_out S D_in^{-1} and edge cost as change of frame are all stated.
Nondegenerate nested labels in an m-dimensional space are stated. The only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4 with loss h, given via the quoted lemma. F^{tensor 3} is not named.
The plan passes from dimension losses to total edge rank without the projections P_V-P_U, the rank=dimension-change fact or the N rank-one source exceptions.
The budget is only alluded to. Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b do not appear.
s<Wm is asserted, but not its reason: L/N=100/539<1/2 and the deficit N-2L>0 are absent.
S1.6 states the endpoint matrices differing by the identity on every input role, giving H<-H+D on every role.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and s calls per node are all stated.

The recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with children of volume V/W and F_k=O(e^tau) is stated. The explicit tau=1-2^{-50} and its derivation from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 are missing, so the conservative verdict applies.

central.summary: P07 reconstructs the outer mechanism of the central saving: frames, labels with only central losses, the endpoint shear, rank-many recursive calls and the recurrence. It skips the quantitative core: rank equals dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L with s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539<1/2, and the explicit exponent tau=1-2^{-50}. The fixed network appears without its triple structure or the sizes h, N and m. Four of nine steps are reconstructed.
